title: Assistant Director, Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence
Senior Product Engineer / AI-Native Tech Lead
Senior Product Engineer / AI-Native Tech Lead
Senior AI Engineer (RAG & AWS Bedrock)
description:
**Role description**  


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Engineer with strong expertise in **RAG** and **AWS Bedrock** to design, build, and operate scalable AI\-powered services on AWS. The ideal candidate will have experience developing production\-grade AI applications, integrating enterprise data sources, building intelligent retrieval systems, and delivering secure, observable, and maintainable cloud\-native solutions. This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, deep AWS experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams while delivering independently within an established architecture.
Key Responsibilities
* Design, develop, and operate production\-grade AI services and applications using **RAG** and **AWS Bedrock**.
* Build intelligent retrieval solutions leveraging **Vectorization OR OpenSearch**, semantic search techniques, and contextual information retrieval.
* Develop and optimize retrieval pipelines involving chunking, embedding generation, indexing, and context enrichment.
* Build and enhance search and retrieval systems to improve relevance, accuracy, and overall user experience.
* Design and integrate APIs and microservices that expose AI\-powered capabilities to enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain scalable cloud\-native and serverless solutions using AWS services.
* Work with enterprise knowledge repositories and contextual data sources to improve information discovery and AI\-driven insights.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and architecture teams to deliver AI platform capabilities aligned with business objectives.
* Implement CI/CD best practices, automation, and deployment pipelines for AI applications and services.
* Ensure solution reliability through testing, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvements in cloud infrastructure, development processes, and AI platform capabilities.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical decision\-making activities.

Required Skills
### **Proficient**


* RAG
* AWS Bedrock

### **Intermediate**


* Vectorization OR OpenSearch

Experience
* 6\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, or AI/ML engineering.
* 3\+ years of experience building and operating production services on AWS.

Why Join UST
* Work on innovative, technology\-led digital transformation programs for global clients.
* Be part of a collaborative engineering culture focused on modern cloud and AI solutions.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, career growth pathways, and cutting\-edge technology initiatives.
* Contribute to impactful solutions that help enterprises accelerate innovation and business outcomes.


  

**Skills**  

RAG,AWS bedrock, Vectorization or opensearch

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.
